name: battle
caption:
NOBODY WANTED HIM? 🎮🏀 Nobody drafted Jamison Battle. He shot 43.3% from three over our first 12 games.

• 2024: undrafted, we sign him, then move him to a two-way deal
• Nov 2024 at New Orleans: 24 points, 6-of-8 from three
• 2026 playoffs, Game 3 vs Cleveland: 14 points, all in the 4th, no misses
• First 12 games this season: 43.3% from three, 20 at the Lakers

Bench spark or starter? 👇

facts.claim: Undrafted in the 2024 NBA draft, signed July 16, 2024, converted to a two-way contract October 19; November 27 (2024): career-high 24 points on 9-of-11, 6-of-8 three-pointers, 119-93 road win at New Orleans; April 23, 2026, Game 3 of first round vs Cleveland: 14 points off the bench, all in the fourth (4th) quarter, perfect shooting
